name: Threshold Deposit Protocol
hypothesis: The repeated failure of mandatory deposit rules stems from agents forcing a return trip immediately after gathering only one item, leaving them under-capacity and unable to amortize travel costs. Evidence shows that maximizing cargo volume (aiming for 3 units) before depositing significantly improves food-per-distance ratios. The optimal strategy is to combine the energy-based trigger for resting (tired: rest) with a strict volume-based trigger for depositing, but specifically delayed until the agent has accumulated 2 items. This ensures agents gather two items then move to the nearest food source to harvest a third, creating a full load (cargo=3), before finally depositing. This maximizes the efficiency of each outbound journey.
